q: A matrix A is diagonalizable over ℂ if and only if the minimal polynomial m_A has:
opts: Degree equal to the algebraic multiplicity of each eigenvalue
No repeated roots (each eigenvalue appears with multiplicity 1 in m_A)
exp: Diagonalizability ↔ m_A has no repeated roots ↔ the Jordan form has no Jordan blocks of size > 1 ↔ the algebraic and geometric multiplicities of each eigenvalue coincide. This is equivalent to the eigenspace decomposition spanning the full space.
